description: Find lobbyists by name or registrant in mode search, then retrieve filing-scoped evidence with mode activity, lobbyist_id and filing_year. Pass an evidence filing_uuid to uslobbying_search_filings for the complete filing. Covered positions are disclosed text, not verified present employment. Activity mode checks the requested lobbyist locally; evidence activities carry description and lobbyist lists only when include names them. Follow next_cursor for all results.

client_id.description: Optional activity client relationship record ID from candidates[].id in uslobbying_get_client_profile resolve mode; candidates[].client_id is secondary.

covered_positions_only.description: Activity only: require this lobbyist’s nonblank covered-position disclosure.

cursor.description: Continue the original scope; omit the other fields or repeat them unchanged, since a changed value (page_size included) fails cursor_invalid. Only max_pages may change per call.

filing_year.description: Required report year in activity mode.

include.description: Activity mode only: lobbying-activity fields to return in evidence[].activity, activity_descriptions (description) and activity_lobbyists (lobbyists). Fields left out are removed; nothing else is. Default []. Fixed for the scan: a continuation omits it or repeats it unchanged.

max_pages.description: Most upstream pages fetched per call, at most 5; larger values clamp and are disclosed in delivery_limits. Discovery fetches only while fewer than page_size matches are pending. Default one for discovery, five for analysis.

mode.description: search (default) finds identities by name or registrant; activity requires lobbyist_id and filing_year. Omit with cursor.

page_size.description: Whole records delivered per call: identities in search mode (default 25, at most 25), evidence rows in activity mode (default 25, at most 1000). Larger values clamp to the mode's ceiling and are disclosed in delivery_limits. Not the upstream page size; a page is short only at the end of the result or while acquisition is still collecting.

name: uslobbying_search_lobbyists

covered_position.description: Reported covered-position text, not verified employment.

lobbyist.description: Filing identity; registrant comes from the parent. All source fields are retained.

anyOf.description: Digit-string identifier; leading zeroes are meaningful.

attribution.description: Required verbatim attribution for LDA data.

complete.description: Whether every source partition has been exhausted.

upstream_count.description: Latest partition counts summed only when all are known; includes duplicates, not an immutable snapshot.

delivery_limits.description: Clamped controls for this call; an empty map means no clamp. Immediate cursor replay retains its original values.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_filter`: Invalid scope, identifier, reference code or mode combination, or an over-cap page_size or max_pages while clamping is disabled. `cursor_invalid`: Unknown, expired, stale or mismatched continuation. `acquisition_storage_unavailable`: Storage cannot safely retain a checkpoint. `pagination_invalid`: Invalid or nonprogressing upstream pagination. `source_schema_changed`: Successful source response violates its verified schema. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

evidence.description: Matched filing-based participant evidence in activity mode.

activity.description: Matched activity; description and its lobbyist list appear only when include names them.

covered_position.description: Reported covered-position text, not verified employment.

lobbyist.description: Filing identity; registrant comes from the parent. All source fields are retained.

lobbyists.description: Complete identity records in search mode.

next_cursor.description: Next acquisition or output window cursor.

output_complete.description: Whether all result rows have been delivered.

records_returned.description: Whole records delivered in this window.

total_records.description: Exact final record count when known.

truncated.description: More data is available through next_cursor; no source data was discarded.
